contentText: US PResident Donald Trump made over $1 billion from cryptocurrencies in the first year of his term, leading to his fortune tripling between 2024 and 2026. Whereas most of that sum comes from his meme coin and his ties to the startup World Liberty Financial, part also comes from legal settlements. Trump is accused of conflict of interests, but the White House has dismissed these concerns. FRANCE 24's Rochelle Ferguson-Bouyahi tells us more.
